scope: EXT-03 baseline matrix, interrupted run unetpp_seed123

interrupted_run.gpu_state_after_interruption: IDLE (566 MiB, 22% util, no CUDA context from trainer)

evidence.boot_type: COLD_BOOT (LastBootUpTime reset, not a sleep resume)
evidence.ac_standby_note: AC sleep timeout is 0 (never); host sleep is NOT the mechanism on AC power

adjudication.origin_note: The proximate host event (power loss vs manual shutdown/restart) is NOT claimed; only that the host stopped logging and cold-booted.
adjudication.resume_rationale: Checkpoint carries complete model/optimizer/scheduler/scaler/RNG state and no partial-write residue; resume is bit-exact eligible and preserves 52 completed epochs.

resume_execution.first_epoch_slowdown_note: Cold page cache after cold boot; steady-state recovery not yet established as of this record.

defect_observation.name: EXT03_CUDA_RNG_STATE_NOT_RESTORED_ON_RESUME
defect_observation.mechanism: Checkpoint is loaded with map_location=<cuda device>, so saved ByteTensors are relocated to CUDA; torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all requires CPU ByteTensors, raises, and the surrounding except Exception: pass swallows it.
defect_observation.verification_method: STATIC_ANALYSIS_ONLY (no live GPU test performed to avoid perturbing the running job)
defect_observation.impact_rationale: Per-epoch sample order is driven by random.Random(seed*100000+ep).shuffle(), not by any global RNG; the pipeline applies no stochastic augmentation. py_rng/np_rng/torch_rng restores are present and correct (torch_rng is explicitly coerced to CPU).
defect_observation.recommended_action: Add the same .to(dtype=torch.uint8, device='cpu') coercion to the cuda_rng branch before any EXT-04 run that relies on bit-exact resume.

matrix_state_at_record.note: registry status for unetpp_seed123 remained RUNNING across the interruption; no status correction was required.
